episodes.name: Seekest Thou the Road
episodes.overviewEn: In small town Westview, Detective Agnes' murder case sends her down a road that changes everything.

episodes.name: Circle Sewn with Fate / Unlock Thy Hidden Gate
episodes.overviewEn: With old foes in hot pursuit, Agatha and Teen gather a desperate coven to walk The Witches' Road.

episodes.name: Through Many Miles / Of Tricks and Trials
episodes.overviewEn: The coven faces their first perilous trial on The Witches' Road.

episodes.name: If I Can't Reach You / Let My Song Teach You
episodes.overviewEn: The coven faces their second trial on The Witches' Road.

episodes.name: Darkest Hour / Wake Thy Power
episodes.overviewEn: With enemies closing in, the coven flees under the light of a blood moon to the next ghastly trial.

episodes.name: Familiar by Thy Side
episodes.overviewEn: Familiar Teen is much more than he seems, and his connections to the rest of the coven are revealed.

episodes.name: Death's Hand in Mine
episodes.overviewEn: Those remaining suffer the hand they are dealt in the next trial.

episodes.name: Follow Me My Friend / To Glory at the End
Maiden Mother Crone
episodes.overviewEn: The truth of Agatha Harkness and The Witches' Road.
